submittedParameters.prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. EDIT ONLY knee, ankle and boot alignment in image1, a single frame of this same mountain guardian boy running NORTHEAST AWAY from camera, back three-quarter view. Preserve its complete upper body, camera direction, proportions, hip location, same staff anatomical right hand SCREEN RIGHT, shield anatomical left arm SCREEN LEFT, costume, rendering, and transparent background. Inputs2 identity,3 committed NE idle direction,4 approved polished Q-style,5 neighboring run phase for consistent leg axis. Correct sideways hip/knee rotation rather than replacing the pose. Legs run in two close parallel fore-aft lanes pointing NORTH-EAST, never side-kick wide, frog kick or roll ankles. Bent knee, ankle center and length of the boot follow one coherent forward/back trajectory. Keep BOTH legs and both complete boots visible, with natural knee bend. No duplicated limbs, sole pasted sideways, extra feet, cropping, shadow or background; real transparent alpha. Preserve this individual frame's action, hand/weapon pose and body phase, not identical to neighbor.Frame02. Anatomical RIGHT leg at SCREEN RIGHT remains the weight-bearing planted foot. Anatomical LEFT leg at SCREEN LEFT is airborne behind body. Fix the extreme sideways swing on left: bring its knee/lower leg inward toward its hip's forward-back lane, with ankle below/behind that knee and boot long-axis in line, same natural backside sole visible as neighbor01, not sole shoved horizontally left. Moderate knee lift and natural plantar flexion. Do not change which foot is planted.
